R620.note: os.Lstat + IsRegular() check rejects any symlink before ReadFile, matching the stated contract exactly; no other behavior change.

R623.note: Simple bounds check field_index >= MAX_FIELDS before array access; correct and minimal.

R634.note: subprocess.run with an argument list and shell=False plus stdout/stderr redirected to the log file removes shell interpretation of target_host and preserves the original combined-output-to-log_path behavior.
